title: Background Agents in Slack Integration
description: Cursor now supports launching Background Agents directly from Slack by mentioning @Cursor. Agents can read Slack threads, understand context, and create PRs without leaving the conversation. This integration requires admin setup and runs agents in secure remote environments.

title: BugBot Automatic Code Review
description: Cursor 1.0 introduces BugBot for automatic code review that catches potential bugs and issues in PRs. When issues are found, BugBot leaves comments on GitHub PRs with 'Fix in Cursor' links for quick resolution.

title: Background Agent General Availability and Jupyter Support
description: Background Agent is now available to all users. Cursor agents can now implement changes directly in Jupyter Notebooks, creating and editing multiple cells. This feature is initially supported with Sonnet models.

title: Memories Feature Beta
description: Introduction of Memories feature that allows Cursor to remember facts from conversations and reference them in the future. Memories are stored per project at individual level and can be managed from Settings.

title: MCP One-Click Install and OAuth Support
description: One-click installation for MCP servers with OAuth support for easy authentication. Official MCP servers are curated at docs.cursor.com/tools.

title: Codeium updates from January 2025
description: Monthly product updates for Codeium extensions and Windsurf Editor including new features and improvements.

title: Introducing Windsurf Next prerelease version
description: Launch of Windsurf Next, an opt-in prerelease version of the Windsurf Editor with new features.

title: DeepSeek R1, DeepSeek V3, and OpenAI o3-mini now available
description: Added support for DeepSeek R1, DeepSeek V3, and OpenAI o3-mini models in Windsurf.

title: Introducing Wave 2 updates
description: Second batch of updates to the Windsurf Editor with new features and improvements.

title: Upcoming deprecation of GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.2-Codex
description: GitHub announced the deprecation of GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.2-Codex models from Copilot.

title: Visual Studio — April update
description: Monthly update for GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio with performance improvements and bug fixes.

title: GPT-5.5 is generally available
description: GPT-5.5 model is now generally available for GitHub Copilot users.

title: Inline agent mode in preview for JetBrains IDEs
description: Inline agent mode feature preview for GitHub Copilot in JetBrains IDEs.

title: Copilot Chat improvements for pull requests
description: Enhancements to Copilot Chat functionality specifically for pull request workflows.

title: View and manage agent sessions from issues and projects
description: New feature allowing management of Copilot agent sessions directly from GitHub issues and projects.
